classification.difficultyReason: Reconcile tank dimensions, convert volume to litres and express the filling rate in litres per minute before finding time.

inlines.text: Water is being poured into a fish tank at a rate of 2 L every 10 seconds.
The tank is 1.2 m long by 1 m wide by 80 cm high.
How long will it take to fill the tank? Give the answer in minutes.

answer.worked:
For an initially empty rectangular tank:
$$\begin{align*} h &= 80\div100\text{ m} \\ h &= 0.8\text{ m} \\ V &= Ah \\ V &= (1.2\times1)\times0.8\text{ m}^3 \\ V &= 0.96\text{ m}^3 \\ C &= 0.96\times1000\text{ L} \\ C &= 960\text{ L} \\ \text{Rate} &= \frac{2}{10}\text{ L/s} \\ \text{Rate} &= 0.2\text{ L/s} \\ \text{Rate} &= 0.2\times60\text{ L/min} \\ \text{Rate} &= 12\text{ L/min} \\ \text{Time} &= \frac{960}{12}\text{ min} \\ \text{Time} &= 80\text{ min} \end{align*}$$
